translations.web: Who can utter the mighty acts of Yahweh, or fully declare all his praise?
translations.bsb: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
translations.kjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?
translations.asv: Who can utter the mighty acts of Jehovah, Or show forth all his praise?
